ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity pixels localized on the distal lobes and 60% low-intensity pixels concentrated in the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral white contiguous fields on outer lobes; the right lobe white field is segmented by dark vertical intrusions and mottling, while the left lobe white field is bounded by a jagged transition to the central black core.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 22 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; distinct jagged 'staircase' peaks on the left lobe and irregular valleys on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge sweep tapering to sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters on the distal white field of the right lobe and along the superior margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark on the right distal lobe; fine horizontal linear striations visible within the left lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation or notch on the mid-left trailing edge; minor marginal truncation on the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, deeply incised serration pattern on the left proximal trailing edge creating a multi-stepped profile.
